title: saveState
description: Save the open site's cookies and `localStorage` to a JSON file in Playwright's `storageState` format, so later tests can sign in with `loadState`.

anyOf.title: State file path
anyOf.description: Path of the state file, ending in `.json`. A relative path resolves against `outputDir`.

path.title: State file path
path.description: Path of the state file, ending in `.json`. A relative path resolves against `directory`, or against `outputDir` when `directory` is omitted.

directory.title: Directory path
directory.description: Directory to save the state file in. A relative directory resolves against the spec file. Omit it to save under `outputDir`.

overwrite.title: Overwrite existing file
overwrite.description: Whether to replace an existing state file.
